verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only piecemeal export paths: notes go to Google Docs or Sheets, Audio Overviews can be downloaded for offline playback, and Slide Decks can be shared as PDF. Nothing shows a complete, account-wide export in open formats that would let a user take everything and leave. missing for 10: a bulk export of all notebooks, sources, chat history and generated artifacts; export of notes in open formats (e.g. Markdown/JSON) rather than Google-ecosystem Docs/Sheets; any documented migration or takeout path; independent or hands-on corroboration.
